about_the_game:
Contains:
  • 1 Month of Premium - Includes 100 tokens per month, free training matches, full access to the Assistant Manager, and much more!
  • A deck of 10 cards with at least 1 epic and 1 rare
  • A cosmetic shield to spruce up your club (Premium Shield D10)

This dlc must be redeemed in game under Settings -> DLC
This pack can only be purchased once per account
